## Hardware Profiles (`python scripts/cli.py resolve <horizon> --profile <id>`)
- [zero-card-cloud] Zero-Card Cloud: Verified $0 cloud gateways, System-1 decisions, and keyless RAG requiring no credit card.
- [16vram-64ram] 16GB VRAM + 64GB RAM Workstation: Zone 1 pure 16GB VRAM dense brains + Zone 2 64GB DDR5 sparse MoE hybrid.
- [mac-apple-silicon] Apple Silicon Mac (Unified Memory / MLX): Unified memory local inference via MLX and llama.cpp Metal (zero PCIe cliff).
